L2421

Public function `{function}` always diverges but does not declare `Never`.

What

Public function `{function}` always diverges but does not declare `Never`.

Why

Inferred divergence is useful to callers but is not part of the written API contract (D-NEVER2=B).

Fix

Add `Never` to the return type, for example `fn {function}() Never`.
